description: This file defines the 'CheckoutActivity' class, which manages the checkout screen UI and logic in an Android Kotlin app. It handles capturing customer data, managing coupons, displaying cart totals, and submitting orders.

classes.name: CheckoutActivity
classes.description: Main class managing the checkout UI, form data, coupon handling, cart totals, and order submission.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI, sets up form listeners, coupon suggestions, and binds form state to ViewModel.

methods.name: setupToolbar
methods.description: Configures the toolbar with title and navigation behavior.

methods.name: setupFormListeners
methods.description: Attaches text change listeners to input fields, sets up button click handlers, and orchestrates form interactions.

methods.name: setupCouponSuggestions
methods.description: Sets up the dropdown suggestions for coupon codes and their behavior.

methods.name: bindState
methods.description: Binds UI components to the ViewModel's state flows, updating UI in response to data changes.

methods.name: setLoading
methods.description: Updates UI to reflect loading state during order submission.

methods.name: setAllEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables all views within a given ViewGroup.

methods.name: showManageSavedCouponsDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog listing saved coupons, allowing selection or removal.
